questionSnapshot.question: In Aladdin (1992), what does Jafar become when his third wish is granted?

notes: Read all four answers and relevant full topic digests/category context; checked cross-bank matches, wording, scope, category and editorial difficulty. Specified original 1992 film and third granted wish. His earlier sorcery can persist, but the event asks what he becomes with this wish, not every role he has ever held. Genie is the unique transformation.
